reason: Address passive free-fall policy (94% Action 0) by removing Y-descent reward exploitation, adding continuous velocity penalty to discourage uncontrolled acceleration, and activating terminal success signal (+100) to provide a clear goal state. Crash penalty remains dormant per memory evidence that harsh failure signals hindered learning.
preserved_design: diagnostic tracking for fuel and steps
changed_design: Modified position_shaping: Replaced Y-descent reward with Euclidean distance-to-target penalty to prevent free-fall exploitation
Activated terminal_success_reward (+100) in training loop when safe landing conditions are met at termination
Added active velocity_penalty_flight term to penalize high velocity magnitude continuously during flight
risk: High velocity penalty might encourage hovering near ground if step cost is insufficient to drive descent
Terminal success threshold (velocity < 0.5) must be reachable; otherwise agent may give up on landing
Velocity penalty weight needs calibration to balance against fuel cost of braking

expected_metric_changes.fitness_score: Improve (less negative) as agent learns controlled descent

repeatable_bonus_safety_check: Terminal success reward is gated by 'terminated' flag, ensuring it can only be collected once per episode at the final step.
